content.title:
IPMAT Indore 2027:
*the plan starts now.*
content.subtitle: IIM Indore has announced IPMAT Indore 2027 for Saturday, 24 April 2027. Five things for this week.

steps.title: Note what UGAT taught you
steps.detail: While it is fresh, write down which topics felt slow or shaky. That list is your starting point.

steps.title: Take one IPMAT paper, timed
steps.detail: Sit the IPMAT Indore 2025 paper in one go. It shows the pattern and the pace you need.

steps.title: Fix one topic a week
steps.detail: Pick your weakest topic from that paper and practise it daily until it feels easy.

steps.title: Take SA questions seriously
steps.detail: Short Answer questions carry no negative marking, so practise them as hard as MCQs.

steps.title: Read every day
steps.detail: One long article a day builds reading speed and vocabulary for Verbal Ability.

content.saveLine: Send it to a friend preparing for IPMAT 2027.
